reviewed_by: Codex focused active side chat and goal isolation review
reason: Provider and harness API cases check active-turn snapshots, unchanged parent turns, independent harness sessions, and side-chat goal isolation while preserving ordinary fork behavior. The existing side-chat browser case covers entry, retry, adjustable layout, reload, and accessibility at desktop and 320/390/430 px mobile widths. Real-Core LAN cases cover durable independent replies and opening the side chat during an active provider stream on desktop Chromium and 390 px Chromium/WebKit.
exclusions: No native source changed. The UI change is an API-backed interaction without a separate deterministic frontend transformation, so no frontend unit test is selected. Unrelated chat, terminal, search, and provider suites are excluded. Mobile projects emulate devices; physical-device testing is unavailable.
